integrity: Contains a complete algebraic proof and a standalone Python standard-library checker; the latter verifies finite test instances but is not an infinite certificate. The scientific claim has not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes and coefficients which are units modulo the prime. Computes exact equal-value pair counts and the fiber second moment, not individual target fiber laws. An implicitly equivalent older p-adic local-zeta formula cannot be excluded by indexed searching. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the proof.
title: Exact collision reversal for cubic maps over odd prime-power rings
